# BidiLens: Production-Grade Bidirectional Text Engine

> Comprehensive bidirectional text analysis, inline isolation, and Trojan Source security scanner for modern AI applications.

## Packages

- @bidilens/core: Zero-dependency bidirectional analysis, UAX #9 heuristics, streaming hysteresis, and security scanner.
- @bidilens/react: React components (<BidiBlock>) and hooks (useBidi, useBidiStream).
- @bidilens/vue: Vue 3 components and v-bidi directive.
- @bidilens/svelte: Svelte store and action utilities.
- @bidilens/web-component: Standalone <bidi-message> custom element.
- @bidilens/markdown: Markdown-it and Remark plugins for bidirectional AST annotation.
- @bidilens/html: HTML string annotation with <bdi> tag injection.
- @bidilens/dom: Dynamic DOM TreeWalker with mutation observation.
- @bidilens/cli: Terminal scanner and CLI utility.

## Canonical Documentation

- [Getting Started](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): Quick-start guide across web and native platforms.
- [Why Not dir="auto"?](docs/why-not-dir-auto.md): Technical comparison with native browser behavior.
- [Comparison Guide](docs/comparison-guide.md): Evaluating alternatives (direction, bidi-js).
- [Trojan Source Security](docs/trojan-source-security.md): Bidi control vulnerability defenses.
- [Streaming Architecture](docs/architecture/adr/adr-006-streaming-directional-hysteresis.md): Directional hysteresis design.
